design_title: Cross-Project QA / Training MCP Bridge — Governed Packet Exchange Architecture
design_decisions: Every new governed project gets its own sandbox at creation time with own DB, ledger, receipts, startup authority.
QA Pilot has its own DB and its own ledger — it is not just a folder of tests, it is a governed project.
A project sandbox is authoritative only for itself — no direct cross-project writes into another project's authority store.
Cross-project interaction uses governed packets: source DB → signed/exported packet → consumer inbound packet store.
Consuming project tags inbound packets as: advisory_copy | derived_from_librarian | non_authoritative_for_librarian.
MCP is the transport for bounded requests/responses between projects. Owner remains authority.
QA Pilot may inspect governed exports, propose QA artifacts, generate training material — never mutate Librarian authority directly.
DB access is packet-gated: Librarian DB → governed export packet → QA Pilot local derived DB (advisory/non-authoritative).
Training sim in /local is built from exported packets, labeled training_simulated — not real authority.
No cross-project write authority. All proposals flow through governed submit channels with Owner approval gate.
Librarian sprint ledger records Librarian work only. QA Pilot sprint ledger records QA Pilot work only.
If Owner accepts a QA Pilot finding into Librarian, Librarian records a separate Owner-approved intake/decision receipt.

cross_project_protocol.flow: Librarian DB → governed MCP export packet → QA Pilot inbound store → QA Pilot local derived DB
cross_project_protocol.not_allowed: native authority for the source project, direct librarian mutation, owner decision substitution, authority promotion

sprint_breakdown.intent: Define governed MCP packet exchange: allowed packet types, request/response schema, custody fields, read/export tools, submit/proposal tools, forbidden direct mutation, QA Pilot local derived-store rules, Training Sim packet rules.
Add bounded Librarian export surfaces for project-state packet, planning-claim packet, fixture packet, milestone-regression packet, document snapshot packet. No QA Pilot mutation.
Import Librarian QA packets into QA Pilot-local derived storage. Validate source project, packet hash, generated_at, authority_source, custody provenance, read-only/advisory status.
Run regression against imported packets. Output: pass/fail report, claim gaps, fixture gaps, unresolved Owner questions, proposed fixes.
Build /local/training-sim from imported packets. Output: help-doc drafts, training scenarios, simulated Owner/agent workflows, evaluation receipts.

core_rule: Do not let QA Pilot become a hidden second Librarian. The bridge allows: read governed state, test governed state, propose improvements, build training material, simulate workflows, submit reports. It does not allow: directly changing Librarian DB, sealing Librarian work, changing roadmap/taxonomy, changing architecture baseline, promoting training results to authority.

scope_restriction: Design/planning only for this sprint. QA Pilot-local only. No implementation, no Librarian mutation, no cross-project write authority, no runtime changes.
